title: Hussain Aik Nahi Hogaye Katal Rasool-e-Khudah.
body:
Hussain aik nehi hogaye katal Rasool-e-Khudah.
Hussain O minni wa Aana min al Hussaingawah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Na rehnda kalma na koi, Khudah na naam lainda
Bina-e-deen Khudah main, Hussain dheen e panah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Bachanday deen te Quran, inho Shabbir rahay
Quran o pak da noha, hai zikr-e-Karbala.
<<DIVIDER>>
Yazid bangaya saray, jahan di lanat hai
Yazid zulm-e-mujasam, Hussain rab di raza.
<<DIVIDER>>
Tere shaoor ton bala, Khudah di hujjat hai
Issi Hussain de sadqay, mili hai deen nun baqa.
<<DIVIDER>>
Khudah da hukum hai sajday, nun tool dainda rehya
Mera Hussain na maro, Nabhi di aayi sada.
<<DIVIDER>>
Rasool khud hai ya koi, hai aaj Imam aaya
Piya jhalainda hai pathar, te kargaya dadua.
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu aaj te seenay te solay, eh rokhay akhay Hussain
Tu kal ton khaak te sona, rasan galaywich paa.
